content: We used the 200-dimensional GloVe word vectors BIBREF18 , trained on 27 billion words from Twitter (vocabulary size of 1.2 milion words) for Twitter URL BIBREF35 and PIT-2015 BIBREF5 datasets, and the 300-dimensional GloVe vectors, trained on 840 billion words (vocabulary size of 2.2 milion words) from Common Crawl for all other datasets. For out-of-vocabulary words, we initialized the word vectors using normal distribution with mean 0 and deviation 1.
